title: Credit Report Requests Information
notes: The guide gives this dataset the Terminals Information endpoint (#26). Confirm the correct endpoint with CBK.

fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: CRBCODE
fields.description: The code the reporting Credit Reference Bureau (E.g. XYZ 060002)

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency.

fields.name: CREDIT REFERENCE REQUEST CAT
fields.description: Credit reports requested by individual customers or others

fields.name: INSTITUTION CATEGORY
fields.description: Category of instutition. E.g. Comercial Banks, Microfinance Banks, DBFB Banks, Regulated Saccos, Unregulated Saccos, etc. Madatory for 'Non-Individuals, otherwise left blank.

fields.name: INSTITUTION CODE
fields.description: The code of the institution making credit report requests, otherwise left blank for individuals. Madatory for 'Non-Individuals, otherwise left blank.

fields.name: NO OF CREDIT REPORT REQUESTED
fields.description: Total number of credit reports requested

fields.name: CAT REASON CREDIT REPORT REQ
fields.description: Reason for credit report request e.g lending, due to adverse action etc

fields.name: NO FREE CR REPORT PROV TO CUST
fields.payload_key: NO FREE CR REPORT PROV TO CUST
fields.description: Total number of credit reports provided to customers for free
